channel.title: Zambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Zambia, every source cited.

item.title: Man denies paternity of child heard through rumours
item.description: A 23-year-old man told the Kabushi Local Court he cannot accept responsibility for a child he only heard about from neighbours.

item.title: Kalusha Bwalya drainage project nears completion
item.description: Lusaka City Council says the 7.2-kilometre project will improve stormwater management and prevent flooding.

item.title: UTH water project 70 percent complete
item.description: The K69.7 million project aims to ensure reliable water supply for patient care and sanitation at the hospital.

item.title: Zambia candidate withdraws from by-election citing threats
item.description: Forum for Democracy and Development candidate Daniel Chisenga quits Mandevu race, leaving three contenders.

item.title: Zambia president orders end to plot allocation without infrastructure
item.description: President Hichilema directs housing minister to address 1.5 million deficit and prevent unplanned settlements.
